title: Password policy
body: Password requirements: use a long unique password and keep it private.

title: Change while signed in
body: To change a known password, sign in and open Account Settings, then Security.

title: Billing page
body: Invoices and payment methods are available from the Billing page.

title: Forgot-password steps
body: If you cannot sign in, choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. Enter your email, open the reset link, and set a new password.

title: Missing reset email
body: If the reset email is missing, check spam and confirm the account email before requesting a new link.

title: Color theme
body: Change the application color theme from Appearance settings.
